crossRefs.note: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and…
With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed…
Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast…
The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed…
and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’
He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of…
Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode…
He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there…
The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

translations.web: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by Yahweh’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
translations.bsb: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
translations.kjv: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
translations.asv: Then the channels of the sea appeared, The foundations of the world were laid bare, By the rebuke of Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
